_note: Hand-written stat weights per class variant, in Strength-equivalents for melee and Spell Power-equivalents for casters. Every generated preset is confidence 'estimated'. Ratings (critRating, hitRating...) have no known level-30 conversion in Forever yet, so their weights are guesses. dps weights a weapon's damage per second in the main hand; rangedDps the ranged slot. armor applies to base armor plus bonus armor. mainHand: two-hand | one-hand-shield | dual-wield.
